detector_fault_log.fault: F1 - probe 3 read the JSON option title from key `title`; the actual key is `name`, so all 283 JSON twins carried an empty title and every card looked like two competing cards.
detector_fault_log.how_found: self-contradicting output: 70 of 70 selected ids reported ambiguous, which cannot be true given probe 1 had just reported 6.

detector_fault_log.fault: F2 - candidates were grouped by defining SITE rather than by option CARD, so an md card, its JSON twin and the pre-dedup lane card it absorbed counted as three definitions.
detector_fault_log.fix: group by mechanical same-card evidence only: exact normalized title equality, or the authored options[].from dedup map. No similarity guess is allowed to MERGE two candidates, because merging on a guess is the data-loss direction.

detector_fault_log.fault: F3 - 07-OPTIONS-HIJK.md separates id from title with U+00B7, not an em dash, so probe 3 indexed 0 of its 80 cards.
detector_fault_log.how_found: a per-file card count of 0 next to four files reporting 58-75

detector_fault_log.fault: F4 - probes 1, 2 and 4 capped scanned files at 4 MB, silently excluding command-center/WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json at 5,284,323 B - the single most important consuming document in the program.
detector_fault_log.how_found: the catalog was absent from the consuming-file list although a direct grep had shown M-29 and M-31 in it
detector_fault_log.fix: cap raised to 16 MB; probe 4 asserts catalog_now_scanned
detector_fault_log.consequence_if_unfixed: the headline 'does the Prompt Two catalog mis-bind an option id' would have been answered without reading the catalog

detector_fault_log.fault: F5 - probe 5 built the reference context from a SINGLE line. Markdown hard-wraps split sentences, so at 16-GRILL-QUEUE-PHASE2.md:617-618 the annotation 'doc-13 mechanism namespace' sat on 617 while the token sat on 618. Probe 5 saw only '...universe M-29...' and returned a confident doc07 binding for a site whose source text says the opposite.
detector_fault_log.how_found: reading the raw lines after the classifier disagreed with the human-visible text
detector_fault_log.fix: probe 6 widened the window to +/-2 lines
detector_fault_log.consequence_if_unfixed: a confidently WRONG binding in the data-loss direction - precisely the failure this unit exists to catch

detector_fault_log.fault: F6 - the +/-2 window then introduced false POSITIVES by context bleed: OWNER-QUESTION-PACKET.md:665 bound M-36 to MECH-36 'Workflow-run-record retention' because the next line says 'Record the F-B-02 closure', and PROMPT-ONE-FLOOR-AUDIT.json:35 bound M-37 to MECH-37 'Test-floor auto-ratchet' because the same JSON object contains 'margin_over_floor'.
detector_fault_log.how_found: reading every site the widened window newly bound to doc 13
detector_fault_log.fix: probe 8's same-line anchor rule - a site may settle only on a signal present on the token's OWN line, uncontradicted at +/-2. A wide-window-only signal is context bleed and may never settle a binding.

detector_fault_log.fault: F8 - the first schema-validator run reported '0 errors' on this artifact while the validator itself had two holes. A mutation test found them: it never implemented the SUCCESS conditional at all (so state=SUCCESS validated clean despite reviewer NOT-REVIEWED, registered=false and an open P1), and its open-defect check matched status == 'open' exactly, which misses the status string actually used here, 'open-owner-action-required'.
detector_fault_log.how_found: mutation-testing the validator (NC-6), not by re-reading it. The clean '0 errors' had already been produced and would have been cited as verification.
detector_fault_log.fix: implement the full receipt_core.allOf[0] SUCCESS conditional and match any status beginning 'open'; re-run the mutation set, now 9 of 10 with the 10th deliberately non-firing
detector_fault_log.consequence_if_unfixed: a green validator that would have certified a fabricated SUCCESS receipt - the exact green-that-measures-nothing shape this program keeps hitting

detector_fault_log.fault: F9 - `python script.py | tail -30; echo EXIT=$?` reports the exit code of `tail`, not of the script. The validator mutation run printed EXIT=0 while the script had actually exited 1. Recorded because a pipeline exit code read this way is a silent false green in any gate script.
detector_fault_log.how_found: the printed EXIT=0 contradicted the visible 'fired_on_bad_state=8/10' in the same output - a self-contradicting output is a detector failure, not a finding
detector_fault_log.fix: redirect to a file and echo $? before any pipe, which is how the re-run was done (MUTATION_EXIT=1 correctly reported)
detector_fault_log.consequence_if_unfixed: any CI step written this way passes regardless of what the script decided

detector_fault_log.fault: F7 - probe 7's control fixture placed its three planted references 2 lines apart, i.e. inside each other's +/-2 window, so every plant contaminated its neighbours and 3 of 3 controls failed.
detector_fault_log.fix: probe 8 rebuilds the fixture with 8 filler lines between plants and KEEPS the 1-line-gap fixture as a known-bad state, because it is a clean demonstration of the bleed hazard
detector_fault_log.consequence_if_unfixed: controls that fail for a fixture reason would have been misread as a detector reason, or worse, quietly dropped

report.coverage_statement: MEASURED: the defining-site index across 7 namespaces; the selection list; the per-card resolution of all 70 selected ids; the reference-site census over 31,305 files in 2 trees; and the per-document binding of all 47 consuming sites on the 6 ambiguous selected ids, under 2 discriminating instruments at 2 window widths with 5 negative controls. NOT MEASURED: author intent at the 21 UNRESOLVED sites; whether any consumer binds against the pre-dedup lane namespace; 2 files above the 16 MB cap; consumers outside the 2 scanned roots; and the 107-substitution count, which is inherited from the prior finding and only its RESULT was corroborated here.
report.method_note: Nothing in this artifact was classified by judgement where a mechanical answer existed. Where the prose carries no discriminating token the site is recorded UNRESOLVED, per the unit's evidence_requirement and because an LLM guess on a mechanical comparison measured 86% accurate on this estate with 100% of the errors pointing at data loss.

codex_reviewer_attempt.prompt_verbatim_summary: Five questions, all answerable from raw files only, with an explicit instruction not to read this artifact or anything under command-center/adversarial/: Q1 count 'MECH' substrings and MECH-\d{1,3} matches in 17-DECISION-LOG.md against a briefing that claims both are zero; Q2 quote the F-B-02 row and judge present-tense vs superseded; Q3 list any '### <id> - <title>' headings in 07-OPTIONS-LM.md for M-12/16/17/19/28/30/38 against the claim that they are ABSENT; Q4 count distinct backtick-quoted X-NN ids in 07-OPTION-UNIVERSE.md section 7 and list the family-M ones; Q5 print every M-29 / M-31 site in WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json with surrounding text and bind each to doc07 or doc13 from that text alone, answering UNRESOLVED rather than guessing when no discriminating word is present.
codex_reviewer_attempt.why_these_five: Q1-Q2 target this unit's headline refutation, Q3 targets the finding that overturns the prior 'resolves to ABSENT' class, Q4 independently re-derives the selection list, and Q5 re-derives the only bindings that live inside the Prompt Two catalog itself. A refuter who answers those five from raw files can overturn every load-bearing claim here without reading a word of it.
codex_reviewer_attempt.dispatch_discipline: Prompt supplied BY FILE (Windows CreateProcess caps a command line at 32,767 chars), --ignore-user-config to keep the active MCP inventory out of the argv, read-only sandbox, blocking foreground call with an explicit 25-minute Bash timeout, and -o for the last-message file. Exit code alone was never treated as completion: the output file was checked and found absent, which is why this is recorded as a failure rather than an empty pass.

extensions.not_a_duplicate_of_ADV-0013: ADV-0013 detects identifier DRIFT between documents over time (which documents still carry the old token after a rename). This unit resolves the CURRENT binding of the selection list. The overlap is one file - 17-DECISION-LOG.md - and this unit's finding about it is that the drift is already repaired there, which is the opposite of the premise both units were briefed with.
